study.question: Does preserving a centered within-block interaction of target equality, historical auxiliary-feedback membership and event values improve click AUC beyond the best averaged-match residual and an equal-capacity duplicate-detail control, and does its effect depend on task-specific residual routing? Observations: source bests are 0.660646940486458 and 0.660163362657485; g0-r0009-match_detail_task reaches 0.6630190236433535 versus matched shared 0.6616459256823809 and count-only task 0.6609444318068068. Field resolution in round10 loses to mean replication in both routing cells: task 0.6619952395455053 vs 0.6627212596577746, shared 0.6612800918427992 vs 0.6617308731161579. All are one frozen training seed, not independent repeated support. The round10 mean control also remains below the smaller incumbent. Preserve averaged field relevance rather than interpreting more channels as beneficial. Earlier unsuccessful trajectories also matter: compressed/task0.6591942389399411 versus events/task0.660163362657485; anchored/task/query0.6604926719194907 versus anchored/shared/query0.660646940486458; generic task contrast0.660580637236507 versus task-capacity0.6606593147778973. They motivate retaining the successful averaged match detail rather than presuming compression or task conditioning helps. The incumbent also trades off auxiliary quality: cart/fav/buy AUC0.7509588877163219/0.7681038215454298/0.7223373945553366 versus DIN0.8490697019534956/0.8648974928883688/0.8701822750556283; improved click is not across-task dominance.
study.hypothesis: The current compressed means, action values, global match/value covariance and match counts can lose the joint association between which event matches the target, which event has auxiliary feedback and that event's other field values. In block b let r be the inherited average of valid item/category/brand equality, a be the supplied masked union of cart/fav/buy historical masks, v be the inherited item/action value vector, and C_b(w,v)=sum_i m_i(w_i-mean_b(w))v_i. Keep d=sum_b C_b(r,v)/sqrt(max(N,1)). Add g=sum_b C_b((r-mean_b(r))*(a-mean_b(a)),v)/sqrt(max(N,1)). Thus g is a third centered mixed moment, not a learned feedback scorer or a claim of statistical orthogonality. It vanishes in blocks with constant feedback or relevance and can expose joint value information missing from the marginals. Give the same two-channel [d,g] representation to the existing four-adapter bank. Useful complementarity predicts interaction/task exceeds duplicate/task and the 0.6630190236433535 incumbent at justified measured cost. Routing interaction is a separate hypothesis, not guaranteed by earlier results.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text lines255-277 and317-336 checked: DIN uses candidate-dependent unnormalized local activation and Dice. These are inherited; the new centered deterministic joint moment is computed before existing block means discard information, then consumed by local task adapters. This is not a DIN reproduction or a priority claim.

Pinned benchmark source lines123-170 and204-273 checked: initializes task-specific sequence hubs using multi-task masks and repeatedly aggregates/broadcasts categorical, sequence and task hubs. Here the existing auxiliary union is reused only as a coefficient in one deterministic block moment; no hub, iterative broadcast or SDPA code is copied. Original INFNet paper remains link-only, so original-method equivalence and novelty remain unverified.

Pinned benchmark source lines194-274 checked: tokenizer mixes feature-derived and learned query tokens to retrieve sequence information using attention. This study keeps the local30-slot scorer and adds a deterministic equality-feedback moment, with no learned-query tokenizer. Original HeMix paper remains link-only; no priority claim.

Only authorized author README was available and read; it warns its behavior data lacks item IDs. This task supplies past advertisement IDs and category/brand-derived auxiliary labels. No DMR mechanism or quantitative transfer is asserted; publisher paper remains unavailable.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the residual input [context,target,base,match_counts,d] with [context,target,base,match_counts,d,g]. In replacement controls use [context,target,base,match_counts,d,d]. Both moments are computed in all cells in a single two-row block contraction. Cross interaction versus duplicate with task-selection versus bank-average routing, giving a complete2x2 design. All four adapters execute for every task. Auxiliary uses of both d and g are detached with item/action values. Do not alter the scorer, its population, labels, feature visibility, loss, optimizer, seed or host resources. Expanded input adds7,168 dense parameters uniformly to every cell. New adapter first-layer initialization differs from the narrower parent; zero output initialization retains source predictions initially and equal-size cells match each other. Preparation used exact-rational scalar examples (not dataset measurements): r=[0,0,1/3,1/3], a=[0,1,0,1], and v=[1,-1,-1,1] versus its negation, padded to one10-position block. Both examples share total and feedback-stratum value sums, original match/value covariance, relevance counts and match-feedback count, but their unnormalized third mixed moments are+1/3 and-1/3. Constant valid feedback, constant relevance, empty masks and masked-value mutation passed the algebraic checks. This establishes possible representational distinction, not prevalence or predictive utility. Actual torch forward/backward, BF16, masking, initial prediction parity and gradient isolation require host checks.
predictions: Primary information contrast: AUC(interaction_detail_task)-AUC(duplicate_detail_task)>0, and interaction_detail_task exceeds the archived incumbent0.6630190236433535 and both frozen source bests. A gain only over duplicate but not incumbent is useful attribution evidence without selection success.

Routing contrast: report interaction/task minus interaction/shared and duplicate/task minus duplicate/shared; report their difference-in-differences. Positive interaction is needed to claim task-routing-specific complementarity; improvement in both routing cells supports joint information without that stronger claim.

Structural gates: empty history gives zero d,g and no residual correction; g is zero for each block with constant a or r up to finite precision; invalid/padded/special equality and target-action mutations cannot introduce signal. Initial probabilities equal the parent because final adapters start at zero.

Report full validation sample count and four-task AUC/Logloss, all fixed history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts (negative=samples-positive), measured parameters, allocated GPU time, training/wall seconds, memory, throughput and latency. Existing short/long-history bins are predeclared; no feedback slice score is presumed available.

Under the current protocol only preliminary single-seed estimates are possible in this submission; require later paired seeds and paired user-cluster uncertainty if supported by the authorized host before repeated-support claims.
falsifiers: Interaction/task fails to exceed duplicate/task, or gains disappear in permitted paired repetitions: no useful joint-moment effect established in this implementation.
Best interaction variant fails to exceed the0.6630190236433535 incumbent or the quality-cost frontier is dominated: do not promote it even if some component contrast is positive.
Duplicate controls explain any gain over parent, or task routing advantage is unchanged/reversed across information cells: reject corresponding added-information or routing-specific explanation.

Padding, empty-history, special-ID, unknown-target-action or gradient ownership invariants fail, source-equivalent initialization fails, or costs exceed the unchanged host cap: mark execution failure, charge it and do not interpret its AUC.
Signal is numerically negligible or present in too few supplied histories: this implementation has inadequate support; it is not a general refutation of feedback-aware compression.
alternative_explanations: One seed, accumulated validation selection and training-order variation can produce an apparent improvement; repeated same-seed execution does not resolve this.

The feature changes coefficient scale, sparsity and conditioning as well as joint information. Equal parameters and duplicate replacements do not fully isolate numerical conditioning; a positive result warrants a marginal-feedback replacement or scale-matched follow-up before a broad mechanism claim.

The auxiliary union combines different feedback semantics, may be sparse and can reflect category/brand label construction rather than advertisement-specific conversion. Results establish only the frozen official_offline visibility protocol.

Auxiliary tasks can improve or deteriorate even when click improves; task routing changes gradient mixing through shared context and adapters. Report auxiliary outcomes separately, not as selection evidence.

Increasing input width changes random first-layer features, parameter count and optimization relative to parent. The factorial matches these within this suite; parent comparison alone cannot attribute a mechanism.

The existing action embedding component and feedback means may already make the added moment redundant, or block summation may still discard relevant temporal structure. Prior failed compressed-query and field-split trajectories do not resolve these possibilities.

Forward summary computations and nominal parameters are matched in the factorial; backward execution and measured runtimes can still differ when a summary is unused or adapters share gradients. Equal code execution is not an equal-compute result.
